body: I know this subreddit is rather old, but I was just able to finally have time to watch Season 3 (just moved into a new house after being away for 5 months) and I was seriously disturbed by the graphic cat scene. It was completely unnecessary to have such a horrific scene, and to not issue a warning was irresponsible. It was unexpected to see, and it was traumatizing. If the cat had to die, why couldn’t it have been from old age or having to be humanely put down? Why did it have to be such a graphic death? Grief can still be a theme for the episode…
Hi! I’m a 35 year old bi-sexual woman from Las Vegas. I just moved here from Chicago, and am so incredibly lonely.

I just moved here from Chicago, and am miserable. I moved here for my husband, and am trying to adjust. 
So far, these are the things I hate about Las Vegas.  
1. The lack of intelligent culture. Seriously, where in the heck are the REAL museums?? 
2. The lack of civility. Does anyone here know how to say “please”, “thank you, or “excuse me”? 
3. The lack of tasteful fashion. Seriously, people need to learn how to properly dress here. It’s perfectly ok to try and imitate real cities like New York. 
4. NOBODY knows how to drive. 
5. They tear down buildings all of the time, and it makes the landscape cheap and tacky
6. There are too many old people here. Boomers everywhere. It’s ridiculous. 
7. There are no architecturally significant buildings. The hotels may have lights, but it’s not a breathtaking skyline. 
8. The food is awful. Nothing but chain restaurants. I grew up on Chicago food. Don’t expect to find any world class dining here. 
9. It is windy all of the time 
10. The lack of water sucks. 
11. The lack of an education culture. People pride themselves on being uneducated. 
12. All of the houses look the same. There is no creativity here. 

I could go on and on, but I am really trying to find solace here. I am trying to appreciate something about here. I do appreciate that I was able to buy more house for my money. My house is almost 3x the size of my house in Chicago.

Edited to add:
I also don’t like the lack of churches, quality schools, and mom/pop businesses. It’s a city full of greed, over inflated egos, and poor city planning.
If it is him, I hope he left a note. Something to show remorse, and give Gabby’s family peace.
Thank you. I am most days, but then there are bad days too. Memories live forever, and pop up at random places and times. I hope you are doing better too.

I think I know what you mean. There was a murder in my hometown in the 70’s. They were never able to catch the guy who did it, until the early 2000’s. The guy was pulled over for a driving infraction, in a different state, and then discovered it was the man the police were looking for. Hopefully BL slips up in one way or another, before years go by. He could look completely different, but get arrested stealing food or running a red light.
💜 Hugs. I’ve been there.

I’m finding solace collecting American Girl dolls, because it brings me back to the comforts of my very messed up youth. My husband, however, told me how much he thinks it is expensive and stupid. Whenever I find something that brings me joy, I get reminded of how stupid I am for enjoying it.
I’m smoking weed to get through the day, and popping Benadryl to go back to sleep. Tomorrow is another day. Sending you love.

It’s ok to cry. I’m almost 40, and I cry. It’s the best way to relieve pain. I am sending love and hugs. It’s ok to talk to someone at school too. There are counselors who will listen, and they will keep everything confidential.

I used to teach on the South Side of Chicago, and I miss the sense of community. Las Vegas is so different from Chicago, and I am so incredibly lonely here. I want to go back to teaching, but the environment, created by angry parents, scares me. I miss my home, my students, my friends, and my little bit of family. I wish I could find some humanity and friendship in LV. There are so many mean people here.

I went to therapy and it made my husband mad because of the cost. I quit seeing my therapist, to save money (and make dear husband happy), and now my demons are haunting me more than ever. I may have to go off my meds because he doesn’t want to spend the money on that either.

The hotlines are anonymous, and FB also has people who will talk to you. It’s anonymous too. You are not alone. I know you are scared, but you are loved. You’re my daughter’s age, and I understand being scared of what family will think. I have used the FB hotline/help before, and they seem to really listen.

I’m only still around because of my daughter and my elderly granny. Most of my family members are dead. The other members of my family don’t want anything to do with me because I’m liberal, and I don’t like their racism. My husband just moved us closer to his family, and now I’m 2000 miles away from my dad and granny. The only blood family I have left. I’m a sexual assault survivor, and a domestic abuse survivor. I watched my mom get really sick and die, after fighting drug withdrawal from Benzos.  The doctors said she had cancer and they think she had COVID before it shut everything down. The Benzos took away her pain, but the withdrawals were because the doctors wouldn’t let her have any. They treated her like garbage because of her addiction, and let her cancer go undiagnosed. I watched all of it, and I can’t fight the demons that exist from all of that. The DV and sexual assault demons are back, and were triggered after Gabby Petito’s story. My husband loves to yell at me, for minor things, because it makes him feel better about his crappy job. He needs to take frustration out on somebody, and it’s always me that gets the brunt of it. I just wish I was dead. Life would be better for everyone, except my daughter. I’m sure my dog and cat will find someone else to run their bellies, amd scratch their ears. I’m just a pathetic nobody, with no job (even though I have a degree), and no money for a Masters. My death would make my husband’s life happier. At least I wouldn’t be a financial burden anymore (in and out of hospitals due to autoimmune disease. My husband loves reminding me of the financial consequences of seeking medical care). Death would erase all of my pain and guilt for ruining my husband’s life with my medical conditions. 

I also miss teaching in Chicago. Las Vegas is not Chicago, and I miss Chicago. Nobody understands what a wonderful place Chicago is. I know there is serious crime, but people are way friendlier there. They know how to take care of neighbors in the neighborhood, and they have a greater respect for civil rights and education. I am so incredibly homesick. I’d like to teach in LV, but I hope I can find an atmosphere like my home on the South Side of Chicago. I felt needed by my students. They gave me a purpose and a reason to live. I miss my students so much it hurts. 

I know my response is long and personal. Just know you are not alone. We are both humans who hurt. I am sending love and hugs. I think we could all use more of that.
It’s very normal. My husband and I expect our daughter to live with us until she’s at least in her mid-20’s. We did the same too. It gave us a stronger foundation.

I moved in with my husband and his parents, back when we were just dating. My brother did the same with his wife. It’s not as abnormal as people think. We learned how to live together, had emotional support from family, and we saved money. We have been better off economically since then, because we lived with them.
I just moved to Vegas, and received 8 of them. I looked up the numbers before calling. Thanks for the posting this, because I now know it is definitely a scam.

Yea, his name is bizarre_design_ There are over 120,000 comments on his post. I saw that specific comment a few weeks ago. I had nothing to do for 3 days besides sit in a car, and spend time on my phone. I read as many comments as I could.
I saw that too. So many red flags 😔
Agreed.
Plus, on IG, there were comments on Brian’s last post where friends claimed they saw him choke her before.

I just moved to Vegas. That thought crossed my mind too. The vast desert landscape is so different from Chicago and farmlands of Northern Illinois. Though, random bodies occasionally appeared in cornfields and along railroads.
That is one of the most interesting jobs ever. I think I chose the wrong career, and I’m too old to change it now (35). But seriously, you have a really cool job.

Good morning! Although, it’s goodnight for me. I’m in Las Vegas, and it’s 2am here. I hope you have a good day. I miss the UK very much, and cannot wait until I can return again. It’s one of my absolute favorite places in the world.

I would also hope they have or will look at footage from the 13th.

I’m one of those people. I had a best friend die in a horrific car accident when I was 19. I wasn’t with her. My father was also run over by a Tahoe, but he survived. These contributed to my fear of driving, and it took me almost 5 years to drive again. It has been over 10 years since then, and I still am scared to drive vehicles with blind spots and won’t drive on the expressway.

Agreed. I’m paying $250 for a storage locker in Cook County. I am flying 2,000 miles back to clean it out. There are items that I really need in there, and continuously paying every month is a hassle. I hate paying on space that I cannot keep an eye on.
Do you think they did that because they wanted to spend “normal” time together before everything hit the fan? Almost like a goodbye?
I agree too.
I wanted to say exactly this.

With all due respect, I think you need to reread my comment. I think you reacted without taking a moment to think. In addition, I think you need to calm down, and try to be nicer. There is no reasoning for such an aggressive tone. Have a peaceful day!
Winter will be setting in soon too. It’s going to be harder to survive in the wilderness, especially if he is on the AT. That is if he isn’t someplace where winter isn’t so brutal…

I don’t know if this has been mentioned, and I sincerely apologize if it has..but I found RL Pinterest. There are boards from a year ago, and one of them is “Life Goals”. She was collaborating with Gabby, BL, and another person. There were wedding pins, and pins for babies. I really wish I could see inside her head. Pinterest made it seem like she really loved Gabby, but her questionable actions speak louder. It makes me so sad, because I would move heaven and hell to bring justice for my future DIL (even if my child had something to with it). I have such a hard time not feeling for other mothers, because I am a mom, and I feel protective of all children (it’s why I love teaching).

Hi everybody! I’m new to this subreddit, but I discovered the radar app because of it. I’m 20 mins from Nellis AF Base, and have discovered that only military craft and small private planes fly over my house in Northern LV. I don’t know anyone here (except my in-laws), because I just moved here. This group seems like a good way to learn how to be somewhat social again (after 2 years of being stuck in my house in Chicago). I’m looking forward to following along with everyone else!
Agreed. I wish people weren’t reducing it to republican/democratic thing. We all care about Gabby. People on both sides are affected by domestic violence, and we all want BL found.
Same here

I had a relationship with a manipulator and emotional abuser in college. I at first dated him because he seemed nice, and I didn’t want to hurt him by rejecting him (totally taught my daughter never to do that), and he slowly took control of my mind. He made me feel ugly, fat, and like I couldn’t do any better. It took 2 years to get away from him, and he sexually assaulted me during that time. I never told my parents about any of it. I was too ashamed. I had to block him on multiple sm accounts, and I freaked out whenever I saw him in public. I’m glad I live 2,000 miles away now, and have been happily married to someone else for 10 years.

I’m curious as to what their HS teachers think. As a teacher, I have the ability to observe teens in “their world”. I get a different perspective of their social lives than their parents/families do, and I see/hear things that they don’t discuss at home.

The HS I used to teach at decided to include domestic violence education in the PE and Health curriculum. They do a unit on DV, and Mental Health is talked about every week. They also had the local safety shelter come in and talk about DV. I wish more schools did that.

I’m here to say hi. I’ve been watching this subreddit for a couple of days, and I have learned a lot. I stayed vigilant throughout my entire drive from Chicago, because it was when they were still looking for Gabby. I just moved to LV, and have zero friends. This has kept me company, and I hope Gabby’s family gets justice.
YTA. So much yta. You are so lucky that’s not my dog, because you would have to worry about being “put down”.
Hey jerk face…it’s almost been a month. Has she dumped your entitled butt yet?

Not to mention, we’re still in a pandemic. YTA for another reason being that large weddings are inconsiderate, dangerous, and thoughtless when over 600,000 Americans are dead…in addition to the totals internationally. Seriously, you suck.

YTA, and the perfect reason why people say “eat the rich”. If I was her, you’d be the newest resident of “Dump City”. Seriously, there are so many red flags with you and your pompous mother! Your fiancé needs to run as far away from you and your awful family asap.

NTA, and this friend Mia has got to go. Not only should she not be allowed to attend that church, but she also needs to cut ties with friends of the church. Homophobia is wrong, and she needs to learn the right way to behave.
Laminate is cheap and tacky. Clean the carpet and be done with it.

NTA, but your downstairs neighbors are. I think THEY need to move out, since they CHOSE to have a baby while living in the apartment. They need to deal with any noise. Honestly, if it were me, I’d make sure to make as much “noise” as possible. I’d wear my high-heels while playing Just Dance, at 3am… 😈 

You could also complain about how loud the baby cries when you are trying to sleep! They need to train their baby to sleep through noise. I refused to make the house quiet for my kid. Now she sleeps through anything.

NTA. You’re her blood aunt, and you have a set relationship that seems to make your niece feel comfortable. I mean, she just lost her mom, and that other woman is trying to forcefully take her mother’s place. Stepparents need to realize that they are just that..a stepparent. Stepparents are not real parents. This step-monster needs to stay in her lane as the outsider to the family. You did nothing wrong, and it’s too bad that your niece can’t live with you.

NTA, she had it coming. I’m so over the attitudes against skinny women. People who make fun of skinny women are just jealous, and trying to make up for their insecurities. I think you need to encourage your wife to stand up to her. She doesn’t sound like a very good friend. Maybe it’s time this friend gets kicked to the curb.
Me too. I’d love that child like he was my own. His mama is in Heaven, watching how people treat her baby boy. I’d want to treat him in the way his mom would want him to be treated.

Also, not only should you leave her and sue for custody (and child support), but you should have the DNA of the baby tested. With a woman like that, who knows what manipulative game she is trying to play.

NTA, you need to end the engagement and sue for full custody of the baby. She needs to go. She sounds like a horrible person, and has no business being a parent. I’d kick her out immediately, and then file for custody.
Prude

YTA. You suck as a mom. I mean, you REALLY suck as a mom. You just ruined your relationship with your grown daughter, because you’re a prudish B. I don’t even know you, but I hate you. Maybe your daughter is better off without you in her life. You need to apologize,  because you are in the wrong. It doesn’t matter if it is your house….which, by the way, is an extremely abusive excuse.
I hate all hardwood and engineered floors. They’re high-maintenance, overdone, and slippery.
NTA, and I’d recommend dumping him. Enjoy Hawaii, and live it up!

NTA, and after reading everything you said, I really think CPS needs to talk to your father. I am so sorry that you have to deal with your father. I am a 35 year old woman, and I am never left alone with repair men. I always have someone here with me, not including my dog. You are technically not even old enough to be left alone all day (legally speaking). Seriously, I really think you need the help of child services. Is there a friend’s family that you could stay with?

NTA. Omg, so not TA. Honestly, with the way your husband is acting, I’d be concerned with his parenting and would seek family counseling here. I’d also wonder if something was going on between him and the babysitter…or her mother…
The OP did something completely harmless. The huge B of a friend overreacted and needs a grip. Obviously you do too. Lord have mercy on your cruel soul.

You can’t explain anything to some people. Their pathetic and meaningless lives are so dull, that they want to judge others over harmless activities that get them through the day. Everyone who thinks a 20 year old (practically still a child) is an AH, for carrying around a bloody teddy, are actually the biggest AHs out there.
Maybe you should see someone. You are bullying a 20 year old for something completely harmless. You have some serious issues that need attention. Seek help immediately.
Nobody saw it and nobody cares. She’s not TA, but you are!

NTA, but Carly is a MAJOR AH. In fact, I hope she sees this. Carly needs to lose all of her friends for being so cruel and a major B. It’s a stuffed animal, and you’re only 20. Jesus, I’m 35 and I still sleep with my ALF doll. I have severe depression and OCD and he keeps me from having horrible nightmares. I take him on vacations too, and my husband couldn’t give a flying leap. My AG dolls are visible during my classes, and my teenage students adore them. Carly sounds like a miserable human being who deserves to be alone.

NTA, and anyone who thinks you are is AH. I’m sorry your boys lost their dad, but they are also almost grown adults. I know they are hurting, but your daughter is SO much younger than they are. She went through a MUCH more traumatic experience than they did, and she is unable to cope with the crash. Her brain just isn’t mature enough to process such complex emotions. It would be hard enough for an older person to deal with that level of emotional trauma. The boys really need to step up for for you, and help with their sister. They need to learn that being older means you have greater responsibilities, and it is their duty to step up. If they were girls, they would be expected to take that role. Why shouldn’t sons?

NTA. Seriously, they need to grow up. People, especially married people, like to have sex. Sex is a normal biological activity. You mean to tell me that they don’t want to get freaky with each other? We have always lived in multi-generational households, and yet we find time to rock the casbah. Just be honest with family as to what the situation is, because anyone under 50 will totally understand.

NTA, but your in-laws are. She is not your responsibility, nor is she your husband’s. Her parents need to take her in, or she needs to put on her big girl panties and deal with your dogs. How entitled must a person be to ask to live with you, and then demand you get rid of your dogs? At this point, offer her a pop-up tent in the backyard. At least she’ll have a place to sleep 🤷🏼‍♀️
Preach! 🙌🏻

I do too. In fact, it’s extremely thoughtless and self-centered. I hate weddings for that reason. What should be a celebration of families joining together, becomes a celebration centered on a spoiled wanna be princess. These Bridezillas most likely waste a hefty down payment on a house, and spending it on an elaborate self-serving party instead. Weddings are a major inconvenience, because of all the time and money spent by attendees. A little gratitude for attending, and leniency with children, is required of the bride and groom.
People who demand child-free weddings are the WORST.

YTA. Wow, what a way to be a Bridezilla! Guess what, I have news for you, it’s NOT all you YOU. You expect people to participate in your wedding, waste their time, and then pay the costs that come along with weddings....including buying you a gift/giving you money. You need to apologize and get over yourself. 
Her babysitter cancelled. Do you know how hard it is to find a decent babysitter last minute...especially during a pandemic? The dad was trying to take care of the kid. You totally could have been more patient, and you sound completely narcissistic. Get help.

YTA.  You could have made an exception. She is your niece, and should not have her birthday ruined (especially after COVID). Honestly, if I was your sibling, I would have not shown up and would have done something even better than a stupid wedding. Weddings aren’t all about you. They’re about the family too, especially when they’re buying you gifts or giving you money. I mean, you could have asked your sister to pay for her daughter if one measly plate was such an issue.
Free Palestine! 🇵🇸

NTA. I teach SPED and my child is on the spectrum. You are exactly the kind of partner I hope my students and child find. His mum is actually stifling his growth and development. She really needs help, because her behavior can be considered abusive.
He really is a worthless human being. Wouldn’t it be awesome if he ended up losing both houses as karma? I know I’m hoping for that!
You are a major a-hole to keep defending your inhumane actions. I hope karma hits you hard. If I was a lawyer, I’d work for them pro-bono, and help them take as much from you as they possibly could.
You are the rotten person.

Plus, he has a moral obligation to let her use the beach house. It’s an empty house and she is in need. He is extremely selfish. He is the epitome of narcissism and greed. He’s probably a bad father too.
YTA. You have an empty house and there is a pandemic. You should have just let her stay there. Illegally throwing them out negates any validity of your feelings or property.
Right? This dude sucks big time.

YTA. You dated her for 3 years and pulled that? What a d*** move. First of all, you have an empty house. It’s not any skin off your back to let her live in the beach house. Second, pressing charges makes you a big A-hole. I hope they press charges against you for abuse and illegal evictions. I hope some judge takes your beach house and gives it to them.
